channel.title: CarExpert Pty Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CarExpert Pty Ltd (carexpert.com.au)

item.title: 2026 Audi RS5: Plug-in hybrid V6 out-muscles RS6's twin-turbo V8
item.description: The new Audi RS5 PHEV serves up a whopping 470kW and 825Nm, and can hit 100km/h in just 3.6 seconds – but it also weighs almost 2.4 tonnes.

item.title: Toyota Yaris to gain electric option with next generation
item.description: The city-friendly Yaris looks likely to benefit from Toyota's policy of developing new cars to accept petrol, hybrid and EV drivetrains.

item.title: 2026 Renault Trafic price and specs: Goodbye manual, hello new auto
item.description: Another nail in the coffin of the manual transmission, with Renault fitting a new nine-speed automatic to the updated Trafic lineup.

item.title: Denza B8, Hyundai Elexio the latest Chinese SUVs to get five-star safety ratings
item.description: The Hyundai Elexio and Denza B8 have received the same five-star safety ratings as their respective Kia EV5 and Denza B8 cousins.

item.title: Re-stocked Honda Civic Type R already sold out despite price hike
item.description: Additional examples of the Civic Type R have been brought to Australia, but only in very limited numbers and at a higher price.

item.title: Still a “significant gap” between Chinese automakers and others, warns GWM boss
item.description: GWM's chairman has made some frank comments about the hurdles an increasingly prominent Chinese automotive industry still faces on the world stage.

item.title: Son searches for late father’s stolen Holden Torana GTR XU-1 to fulfil dying wish – report
item.description: A family’s beloved Holden Torana GTR XU-1 has been stolen from a Melbourne suburb, prompting a call to action from the local car community.

item.title: Toyota GR GT V8 sports car closer to Australian showrooms
item.description: The most powerful Toyota sports car is on the radar for Australian showrooms, as the GR brand expands its local motorsport footprint.

item.title: Toyota Australia and Walkinshaw ‘exploring’ road car opportunities
item.description: Toyota and Walkinshaw will debut the GR Supra race car this weekend, which could see even greater collaboration in the future.

item.title: Hyundai's N division safe in Australia despite tougher emissions laws
item.description: Increasing pressure from NVES CO2 caps won't stop Hyundai from offering its high-performance N cars, the brand's local COO says.
